Checks against a built-in list of 90+ common clichés. Matching is case-insensitive on whole phrases.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste your article, essay or story into the box.
  2. Every cliché from the built-in list is highlighted in your text.
  3. Review the found list with counts, then rewrite the flagged phrases in your own words.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many clichés does it check?

The tool checks your text against a built-in list of 90+ common English clichés, from "think outside the box" to "the whole nine yards".

Is the matching case-sensitive?

No. Matching ignores case and works on whole phrases, so "At The End Of The Day" is found just like the lowercase form.

Why should I remove clichés?

Clichés make writing feel stale and generic. Replacing them with specific, original phrasing makes your work more vivid and credible.
